xshmem.h; PEs one process hosts in the ofi backend (PE = K*rank + l, own GPU/NIC/heap each); 1 = one PE per process
xshmem.h; node-local PEs exchange payload by device copies through hipIpc-mapped DATA heaps (xshmem_ptr) instead of the NIC; ofi backend, one PE per process; inert on cray
pe_geo.c; PEs per GPU (target fallback 2)

comm_xshmem.c; only with rounds (XSHMEM_ROUND_MB > 0)
comm_xshmem.c; signals to member i go on lane i mod N (after every payload lane is quiet)
